announcement.quote: Ares Capital Corporation (NASDAQ: ARCC) and Allied Capital Corporation (NYSE: ALD) announced today that they have entered into a definitive agreement under which Ares Capital will acquire Allied Capital in an all stock transaction currently valued at $648 million, or approximately $3.47 per Allied Capital share.

deals.notes: Prospect Capital made a competing proposal (Jan-Mar 2010) and on 2010-03-05 terminated its solicitation against the Ares deal. Allied stockholders approved the merger on 2010-03-26 (8-K 0001299933-10-001288), but no excerpt states the merger was completed, so outcome is null.
